issue.title: Make google code issue history available on our new website
issue.body:
[Google code is shutting down (for real)](http://google-opensource.blogspot.fr/2015/03/farewell-to-google-code.html)
- March 12, 2015 - New project creation disabled.
- August 24, 2015 - The site goes read-only. You can still checkout/view project source, issues, and wikis.
- January 25, 2016 - The project hosting service is closed. You will be able to download a tarball of project source, issues, and wikis. These tarballs will be available throughout the rest of 2016.

As we still have valuable discussion there we should have a way to make them available elsewhere for consultation.
